title: Work performance assessment in Thai homeless shelters: an exploratory factor analysis
core_idea: To validate a culturally adapted Assessment of Work Performance (AWP) for use in Thai government-operated homeless shelters and to use task-based ratings and exploratory factor analysis to identify functional skill patterns and psychosocial barriers that inform allied health service planning for adults with mental-health-related disabilities.
tldr: Validate an adapted work-performance assessment for adults with mental-health-related disabilities in Thai homeless shelters and identify functional skill patterns and psychosocial barriers to guide allied health rehabilitation planning.
